items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: And the girl that sang it, Berniece -- Berniece Johnson, that was her name

ctx.x: -- (inaudible) because when I read it, I would cry because it was such a beautiful song. And the girl that sang it, Berniece -- Berniece Johnson, that was her name; she was a church person, church woman with a beautiful voice. And in her voice was all the beauty of -- she was clean, if you know what I mean. She -- you think of a nightclub singer, you think of whiskey and dope and prostitution. But this woman and her voice was just, everything was just the opposite.
And when she would sing "One Day," she --
